summary: Executed backend+frontend regression for period-scope accounting rules on public URL; identified one functional backend gap in trial balance opening logic.

critical.issue: opening_balance for tested account remained 0.0 instead of including prior-period net movement (expected 100.0 from 2098-06-30 journal entry).

action_items: Fix /api/trial-balance to roll forward net entries before from_date into each account opening_balance (not only chart account opening_balance field).
Retest trial balance with controlled before/inside period entries to confirm opening_balance and movement separation.
After fix, rerun full requested period-scope regression for journal/ledger/trial-balance/reconciliation endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: In get_trial_balance, entry query is period-only and no prior-entry accumulation is applied to row.opening_balance; this causes period opening underreporting.
Ledger single/all and journal filters correctly enforce in-period rows in tested scenarios, with closing formula consistency validated.
backend/server.py remains very large (>700 lines), increasing regression risk for financial calculations and period logic changes.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST-ITER67 chart account and 4 manual journal entries (before/inside/inside/after period); cleaned with teardown via Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL from frontend/.env used. Pytest run: 5 passed, 1 failed (trial balance opening). /api/journal-entries period filtering passed, /api/ledger single+all passed with in-period rows and closing formula checks, /api/banks/{bank_id}/reconciliation-balance formula checks passed, /api/admin/data-flow-validation is_valid=true passed. UI automation passed for /ledger and /bank/industrial-development/reconciliation (book/check add-subtract breakdown labels present). yarn lint/build succeeded. Installer exists at /app/dist/BankDepositSystemSetup.exe (16987370 bytes).
rca of the issue: RCA: /api/trial-balance initializes opening_balance from chart_accounts.opening_balance only (server.py: around rows_by_key init) and then processes only entries inside from/to range, so net movements before from_date are never added to opening_balance. Reproduction: create account + manual entry before from_date (debit 100), then query trial-balance for later month; account opening_balance returns 0 instead of 100. Mitigation: fetch and aggregate prior approved non-reversal entries (entry_date < from_date) per account and add to opening_balance before period movement totals.
